reference_prolog:
% Facts from the record (arity 0 used for yes/no style predicates)
petitioner_business_owner.
petitioner_performer.
company_produces_events_festivals_theatrical.
proposed_work_independent_performer_of_educational_shows.
submitted_business_plan.
letters_of_support.
articles_on_education_issues.
asserts_programs_advance_child_social_emotional_development.
business_plan_projects_employment.

% No evidence provided of an advanced degree or the five-years progressive-experience master's-equivalent.
% Represented explicitly as failing predicates so evaluation is consistent (arity 0).
has_advanced_degree :- fail.
has_equivalent_master_via_5yrs_progressive_experience :- fail.

% Exceptional ability: petitioner must satisfy at least three of six regulatory criteria AND pass a final merits determination.
% The record does not establish satisfaction of three criteria or final merits recognition.
meets_three_of_six_criteria :- fail.
final_merits_determination_recognizes_exceptional_ability :- fail.

% Qualification for the underlying EB-2 classification:
qualifies_by_advanced_degree :-
    has_advanced_degree.
qualifies_by_equivalent_master :-
    has_equivalent_master_via_5yrs_progressive_experience.
qualifies_by_exceptional_ability :-
    meets_three_of_six_criteria,
    final_merits_determination_recognizes_exceptional_ability.

qualifies_underlying_eb2 :-
    qualifies_by_advanced_degree;
    qualifies_by_equivalent_master;
    qualifies_by_exceptional_ability.

% Dhanasar framework prongs.
% The record contains business plan, letters, and articles which support some merit, so we model substantial merit as present.
prong_substantial_merit :-
    submitted_business_plan;
    letters_of_support;
    articles_on_education_issues.

% National importance requires showing the endeavor has implications beyond a local or regional area.
% The record lacks sufficient evidence of national impact (director denied; no persuasive showing of national scope).
prong_national_importance :- fail.

% Well-positioned to advance the endeavor requires persuasive evidence of capacity to advance it (education/credentials, accomplishments, resources).
% The record lacks the required credentials/recognition to show the petitioner is well-positioned as required.
prong_well_positioned :- fail.

% On balance, waiving the job offer requirement benefits the U.S. requires showing substantial public benefit beyond the individual's business plan alone.
% The record does not demonstrate this balancing in favor of a waiver.
prong_benefits_us :- fail.

dhanasar_prongs_met :-
    prong_substantial_merit,
    prong_national_importance,
    prong_well_positioned,
    prong_benefits_us.

% Final eligibility requires both the underlying EB-2 qualification and the Dhanasar prongs.
eligibility_met :-
    qualifies_underlying_eb2,
    dhanasar_prongs_met.

% Entrypoint and output logic (must be last per instructions).
decision(Result) :-
    (   eligibility_met
    ->  Result = 'Accepted'
    ;   Result = 'Dismissed'
    ).

run :-
    catch(
        (   decision(Result),
            writeln(Result)
        ),
        error(existence_error(procedure, PI), _),
        handle_undefined(PI)
    ).

handle_undefined(Name/Arity) :-
    (   current_predicate(Name/OtherArity),
        OtherArity \= Arity
    ->  format('Programming error: called ~w/~w, but only ~w/~w is defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity, Name, OtherArity])
    ;   format('Lack of information: predicate ~w/~w is not defined.~n',
               [Name, Arity])
    ).
